data.title: 西连寺春菜 · 学园楼梯转角的神摔失重跌坐
data.action: 楼梯转角失衡跌坐，双手撑在木地板上，课本作业散落一地，满脸通红羞愤泪目
data.camera: three-quarter view, floor-level perspective, focus on blushing face and tumbled posture
data.lighting: 走廊高窗洒入的明亮午后阳光与光滑木质地板上的漫反射
data.location: 彩南高校教学楼二楼转角走廊木质地板
data.description: 彩南高校转角楼梯口，春菜不慎踩空，跌坐在明亮的木地板上。她双手撑住身前地面稳住身体，课本和讲义散落在身旁。午后的阳光从高窗洒进走廊，她抬头望向画外赶来的梨斗，脸颊通红，眼里还带着慌乱的泪光。
data.promptProse: Having stumbled at the school staircase landing, Haruna sits on the polished wooden floor with both palms planted in front of her to steady herself. Textbooks and loose worksheets lie scattered beside her. Flushed and teary-eyed from the mishap, she looks up toward Rito just outside the frame, while afternoon light from the corridor windows falls across the boards.
data.animaCaption: Both palms steady her on the floor as she looks toward Rito outside the frame.
